answer: Because the nadir forfeiture is applied at exit, the lotus ledger totals each burn, and the wander audit records the amount lost per key. An operator that moves capital between 20 aliases as a result destroys value on every move, which makes rotation strictly worse than leaving the bond in place. That is 23 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
